issue_headline: Malaysia names Mossad suspects, but no court has convicted one of spying

cards.big: Suspected Israeli operations in Malaysia share a signature: the operative enters on another country's passport.
cards.sub: The 2018 assassins of a Palestinian lecturer used Serbian and Montenegrin papers; the 2024 gunman flew in French. Dubai's 2010 hit squad did the same.
cards.revision: REPHRASED (Stage 3 OVERCLAIM): dropped 'always'; 'It is the method Dubai documented' -> 'Dubai's 2010 hit squad did the same' (softened from singular fixed method to comparator).

cards.big: Fadi al-Batsh, a university lecturer, was shot about 14 times on his way to dawn prayers in Kuala Lumpur.
cards.sub: Two motorcycle gunmen who had entered on fake Serbia and Montenegro passports killed him in April 2018 and slipped into Thailand. No one has been charged in Malaysia; the deputy prime minister said they had links to a foreign intelligence agency.
cards.revision: CORRECTED (Stage 3 MISLEADING/STALE): 'No one was ever charged' -> 'No one has been charged in Malaysia' (Jan 2022 Palestinian authorities reportedly arrested a suspect). ADDED (Stage 2/Gemini, self-verified): escape into Thailand.

cards.big: In 2022, more than a dozen Malaysians abducted a Gaza programmer to force out his phone-hacking software.
cards.sub: Six were jailed five years in 2025 for the kidnapping. The alleged ringleader, a private investigator the home minister told Parliament was recruited by Mossad and paid RM100,000, is still on trial.
cards.revision: CORRECTED (Stage 3 INCORRECT/STALE) + STRENGTHENED (Stage 5 courage): replaced 'thirteen paid... never met who paid them, not one confirmed as agent' (stale/unverified) with the verified July 2025 convictions (6 men, 5 yrs) and the 21 Aug 2025 parliamentary allegation against Nidarahayu Zainal (RM100,000, still on trial).

cards.big: Every conviction so far is for guns or kidnapping, never spying.
cards.sub: Seven years for the Israeli, ten years and six strokes for his arms supplier, five years each for six abductors. Meanwhile about 50 immigration officers were arrested in 2024 for selling foreigners passage through the border.
cards.revision: CORRECTED (Stage 3 INCORRECT): 'Every conviction has been for guns, not spying' -> 'guns or kidnapping, never spying' (July 2025 abduction convictions). Dropped the 'well guarded' clause (Saifuddin's 'very high' referred to spy-detection capability, not the border) to avoid misattribution; moved the reassurance-vs-alarm seam to the view.

cards.big: The danger was never a hidden cell. It is a border that can be bought and locals hired at arm's length.
cards.revision: CORRECTED (Stage 3 UNVERIFIED): 'recruits who never meet the boss' -> 'locals hired at arm's length' (compartmentalized recruitment is supported by the IGP's Nov 2023 statement; the literal 'never met the boss' detail had no primary source).

cards.big: Think of a burglar who never picks a lock.
cards.sub: He pays the doorman, hires local hands who never see his face, and leaves on a passport borrowed from a tourist. The police report says trespassing, not burglary.
cards.revision: REPHRASED (Stage 6 self): ending now mirrors the verified lesser-charge reality (kidnapping/firearms, not espionage).

cards.big: Malaysia's problem was never imagining spies; ministers now name them in Parliament. The cheapest way in, a bought border and deniable hands, stays open while the speeches grow louder. Suspicion is loud; proof, by design, stays quiet.
cards.revision: STRENGTHENED (Stage 5 courage, non-partisan): names the escalation (ministers naming suspects) and the reassurance-vs-alarm gap, WITHOUT publishing Grok's unverified cross-administration patronage hypothesis. Kicker preserved.

introduced_claims.claim: Six men jailed five years for the 2022 abduction (July 10 2025)
introduced_claims.primary_source: Bernama/FMT/The Star, 2025-07-10 (Justice K. Muniandy, six named men, alternative charge of abduction/wrongful confinement)

introduced_claims.claim: Home Minister told Parliament Nidarahayu Zainal was recruited by Mossad, paid RM100,000, still on trial
introduced_claims.primary_source: Bernama id=2459058 + The Star, 2025-08-21; charged under AMLA s.4(1)(b) + Kidnapping Act s.3; bail RM50,000 Nov 2024
Al Jazeera Apr 2018; corroborated by Gemini deep-research report (van switch, border crossing)

synthesis_notes: Over-integration decisions: (1) Stage 5 (Grok) urged naming a cross-administration patronage incentive structure; that claim is Grok's own HYPOTHESIS/opinion with no primary source, so it was NOT published as fact. The defensible, verified part of Grok's critique — the gap between loud official rhetoric and an unreformed border — was folded into the view as analysis, kept non-partisan (no coalition named; anger-at-process, not at people). (2) Stage 3's most material catch was the 21 Aug 2025 parliamentary statement, which made the old 'not one local confirmed as an agent' framing stale; the central tension was re-cut from 'PM claims vs IGP says none' to 'officials now NAME a recruited local, yet courts have convicted only for abduction/firearms and her espionage case is untested'. The verification gap survives, sharper. Compression: 'more than a dozen' preserves the 6-convicted + 8-on-trial reality without asserting a single disputed total (11 vs 13 vs 14 across reporting dates). 3R discipline held throughout: framing targets the state, the method, and Malaysia's own border corruption — never a people or a faith; 'dawn prayers' retained as a verified circumstance conveying brazenness (anger-at-process), not a religious claim. BA estimated at 82 (bias_score ~18): Gemini returned a prose deep-research report, not the bias-audit JSON, but its content corroborated the facts and surfaced no partisan/3R bias; estimate flagged as non-machine. FC held at the Stage 3 number (68) to honestly record the audit of the reviewed draft; the flagged errors are now corrected in this synthesis (real accuracy higher), which is reflected in SR (88). af omitted (Stage 4 retired); ct=62 from Stage 5 courage_score.
